The recent call does NOT contradict the pain — it confirms the same pain points (dev backlog, toplist tool criticality, CLS concerns). The downgrade from 8 to 6 is a re-interpretation of the same evidence, not a contradiction. Currently the analysis conflates 'same evidence read in detail' with 'evidence that contradicts prior score', which violates carry-forward consistency.
